thread:
brynn: Hey finance team — SignalStack pinged about their March invoice. Looks like the pricing experiment that ran in late Feb got backfilled; their unit price changed for 2/15-2/28 and they were charged retroactively. Invoice INV-2026-03-1123 shows a $3,421.50 line they didn't expect.

mike: ugh, that was the A/B pricing test we did with the seed cohort, right? they were on cohort B which should've only applied to new usage after the switch.

brynn: yep. Their email attached the usage CSV and highlighted the billing window. they reached out asking for a pro-rated adjustment or goodwill credit.

sophia: @brynn can you paste the invoice lines? also did we already mark that cohort as experimental in billing? might be a mapping bug.

brynn: invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-03-1123 | SignalStack | 2026-03-12 | usage 2/15-3/14 | 1,234,567 tokens | $3,421.50
Adjustment reason: pricing_experiment_backfill
```

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03-1123 attached to thread. Status: paid. Payment date: 2026-03-13.

mike: If it's paid we need to issue a credit. Quick calc: affected days 2/15-2/28 = 14 days. Their normal rate vs experiment delta is $0.008 vs $0.006 = $0.002 per token. They used ~600k tokens in that window => ~ $1,200 credit estimate.

brynn: customer asked for a goodwill credit if we won't fully reverse. they said they'd stick with us but prefer a partial.

cassie: I'm fine approving a manual pro-rated credit of $1,200.34 as goodwill. Flagging Legal? no need. ops/finance to execute.

sophia: I'll prepare the manual adjustment. Need the invoice id and GL code. Using GL: BILL-ADJ-2026. Can someone confirm the amount $1,200.34 to two decimals?

mike: confirmed $1,200.34

brynn: customer-facing note: "We're issuing a $1,200.34 credit to correct a pricing backfill that incorrectly applied to Feb usage. Apologies for the confusion and thanks for flagging." They asked for it to appear on the next invoice.

sophia: done — created credit memo CM-2026-0456 for $1,200.34, linked to INV-2026-03-1123, GL=BILL-ADJ-2026. Will post on the next statement.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-0456; status: queued. Will apply on 2026-04-01.

cassie: Approved by finance lead. :white_check_mark: Please cc me in the outgoing note.

brynn: sending reply now. cc @cassie

mike: customer reply already: "Thanks, appreciate the fast turnaround." :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Credit CM-2026-0456 applied to customer account on 2026-04-01. Thread resolved.
